findings.evidence: Charts.lean:216-262 (data fields free of `k`), 311-316, 528-535; Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/Basic.lean:783 (`IsManifold ... : Prop`), :822 (`IsManifold.of_le`), :847-866 (`LEInfty`/`2 → 1`/`3 → 2` are the only downward instances); `ENat.one_le_iff_ne_zero_withTop` in Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/ContDiff/Defs.lean:352.
findings.fix: Fix the level: state the structure once as `instance [IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n + 1)) 1 M] : ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ↥((𝓡∂ (n+1)).boundary M)` with no `k`/`hk` argument (internally `one_ne_zero`), then keep `isManifold_boundary`/`isImmersion_boundary_val`/… for general `k` with `hk : k ≠ 0`, deriving `IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) 1 M := .of_le (ENat.one_le_iff_ne_zero_withTop.2 hk)`. `IsManifold` is a `Prop` class, so all such derivations are defeq and the structure is canonical; this also removes every `letI` in the statements and makes the `Smooth` section (lines 521–537) unnecessary.
findings.issue: `boundaryChartedSpace` is indexed by `k`, `hk : k ≠ 0` and `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) k M]`, but none of its data depends on them (`toFun`/`source`/`target` of `boundaryChart` are `k`-free; `hk`/`he` occur only in proof positions). The consequence is a `C^∞`-only instance surface: with `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) 2 M]` or `5` or general `k ≠ 0` there is no `ChartedSpace`/`IsManifold` instance on the boundary at all (Mathlib's chain gives `IsManifold I 1 M` only from `∞`, `ω`, `2`, `3`), and since the def is `@[irreducible]` the structures obtained at two different `k` are not interchangeable terms.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:452-454 — the proof is `((𝓡∂ (n + 1)).isClosed_boundary hk).isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal`; `ModelWithCorners.isClosed_boundary` is general (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/InteriorBoundary.lean:334) and `IsClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal` is a general topology lemma (e.g. Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/Intrinsic.lean:185).
findings.fix: Move it to the `ChartIndependence` section and state it for general `{I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H}`: `theorem isClosedEmbedding_boundary_val (hk : k ≠ 0) : IsClosedEmbedding (Subtype.val : ↥(I.boundary M) → M) := (I.isClosed_boundary hk).isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal`; use it at `𝓡∂ (n+1)` in `isSmoothEmbedding_boundary_val`.
findings.issue: `isClosedEmbedding_boundary_val` is stated inside the `Boundary` section, so it carries `[ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace (n+1)) M]` and `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) k M]`, but its proof uses nothing about the half-space or the dimension: it holds verbatim for an arbitrary `ModelWithCorners`.

summary: The half-space specialization matches the roadmap and the chart-independence lemmas sit at the right level, but the charted-space structure is parametrized by `k` and `hk` although its data uses neither, which strands every finite `k > 0` with no instance; and `isClosedEmbedding_boundary_val` is confined to the half-space model despite a proof with no half-space content.
